about_the_game:
In the demo, you can play Area 1 (Stages 1–5) and face the Area Boss.

If you’re unsure whether your system can run the game, we’d be happy for you to give the demo a try.

As long as the number displayed at the bottom-left of the game screen stays close to 60, you should be able to play without issues.
